findings.reason: without the seat kept mode 000 the section ships one of its three repairs with no arm that could fail, so a builder may pass the gate having left the PermissionError propagating.
findings.text: the fixture "holds … a mode-000 seat" and then "makes every file under the crew home mode 0444", so the chmod sweep rewrites the seat to 0444 and the change "An unreadable seat reads as an unknown holder rather than raising" is never exercised: at the base, `_probe_seat_read_only` (reckon/crew/runs.py:3658-3661) opens a 0444 seat read-only without error, so no arm of the test can fail on that mechanism

findings.reason: the Change promises reads never unlink, and the gate as written cannot tell "reported stale" from "unlink attempted and swallowed"; one writable-home arm asserting the dead lease file survives the read would settle it.
findings.text: the byte-identical assertion and the dead-lease arm run only on a 0444/0555 tree, where no write can succeed, so an implementation that merely catches `OSError` in `release_holder` (reckon/crew/host_lease.py:149-160) passes the gate while a read on a normal writable home still unlinks the stale lease

findings.reason: the coordinator fences exclusive scopes from the declared write paths, so the decisive edit lands unoutfenced, and a builder following the spec literally is blocked at a file its section does not grant.
findings.text: §18 names `_fresh_watch_holder` bare and declares its write paths as `reckon/crew/follower_registration.py`, `reckon/crew/host_lease.py`, `reckon/crew/runs.py` and the test file, but `_fresh_watch_holder` is defined in `reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:41` and it is that body that calls `lease.release_holder(holder)` (:52); to make a read report the stale lease rather than unlink it, a builder must edit `watch_unit.py`

findings.reason: the document's convention already places gate logs under the run directory and earlier reviews of §10 and §11 were answered on that basis, so naming it would restate the convention rather than change what the builder does.
findings.text: §18 states a negative control but names no path for its log, where §16 and §17 name "the run directory"

rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §18's fixture makes every file under the crew home 0444, which erases the mode-000 seat it also places there (plan.html:216).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: a finding — §18 names no durable log path for its negative control (plan.html:216), unlike §13, §15, §16 and §17 in the same document.
